class.name: EditorExportPlatformPS1
class.brief_description: Exporter for PlayStation 1. Writes a PS-X EXE by spawning blazium-toolchain. No Godot export templates.
class.description: [EditorExportPlatformPS1] appears in Project → Export as "PS1" on Windows and Linux hosts only. Export cooks assets then runs [code]blazium-toolchain ps1 setup[/code] (if needed) and [code]ps1 build --out[/code] using the guest stub bundled in the toolchain. Optional Editor Setting [code]export/ps1/runtime_src[/code] overrides [code]--src[/code] for engine authors. One-click runs [code]blazium-toolchain ps1 run[/code] (pcsx-redux + OpenBIOS). GDExtension and C# are rejected. This class does not call [code]find_export_template()[/code] or [code]save_pack()[/code].
